GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down Inside 7th 6 Lengths @ 1000m. off rail 5th to home Turn . Kept Finding line, 2.5L back to 4th # Sound finish
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 10 lengths. well back turn getting up fence. ran on very strongly along fence # big win

Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed same until improving 3 Wide from 550m & pushed to quicken @ 450m. Held up Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & worked to challenge leader @ 100m. Drew clear late. # Had last crack.

Crowded @ start. Pushed to recover & raced Worse than midfield on inside (6L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken Two Wide @ 600m. Improving 3 Wide @ 500m & Five Wide @ 400m. Held up Six Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Badly hampered @ 250m & in 3 Wide @ 200m & not ridden out late. Vetted clear. # Found trouble
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping crowded for room b/w two other rnrs, both of which shifted ground. When QUST RE his riding rounding the home turn & in the h/s, rider stated that he had EST a position to the inside of another rnr heels rounding the H/T, causing him to shift in & attempt to obtain a run rather than continue out & around that rnr. Held up for clear running in the early part of the h/s & unable to obtain clear running until near the 100m. When queried RE his vigour once EST clear running, rdr explained that he felt his mount was not in a competitive position to do so. Post race vet, no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat back 4l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, half off 100m, kept on strong # no match 1,2

Bumped @ start. Niggled to recover & raced Worse than midfield on inside (5L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken @ 400m & held up 3 Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & chased soundly in last 200m. # Margin unfair.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: slow out x 2-3L. Immediately a Clear last. gave Lead about 10 Lengths @ 800m. Same Position Straightening Up , Just Held Ground well back (vetted - no abnormalities) # always well back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and made heavy contact another runner and lost ground. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back 5l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was taken wider rounding the home turn by another runner.
